question: Who among the following won the Formula One 2022 Bahrain Grand Prix?
solution:
The correct answer is __Charles Leclerc.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

 
• Charles Leclerc of Ferrari won Formula One season-opening Bahrain Grand Prix on 20 March 2022 defeating Max Verstappen.
 
• It was Ferrari's first win since 2019
 
• Lewis Hamilton was in third place for Mercede
